contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ GALLIENVS AVG ; R/ LAETITIA AVG

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Gallienus (253-268), mint of Rome issue of 253-255, third series (b), Cunetio no 1598, Reece period 12. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: GALLIENVS AVG. Reverse description: Laetitia left holding wreath [Cunetio gives purse] in right hand and anchor in left hand. Reverse inscription: LAETITIA AVG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 3 no. 10251. Diameter: 21.5mm, Weight: 2.67gms, die axis: 12
